title: 求职信·咨询信·投诉信·道歉信·祝贺信
desc: 覆盖求职、咨询、投诉、道歉、祝贺五类书信的正式句式与套语，按信类分段便于直接背诵套用。

entries.en: I am writing to apply for the position of ___ advertised in ___.
entries.zh: 我写信是想申请贵方在___上刊登的___一职。
entries.example: I am writing to apply for the position of English editor advertised in China Daily on May 10.
entries.exampleZh: 我写信是想申请贵方5月10日在《中国日报》上刊登的英语编辑一职。
entries.note: 求职信第1段开门见山：职位+信息来源。advertised in后接媒体名，勿写for your company。

entries.en: I am writing in response to your advertisement for ___.
entries.zh: 我写信是想应聘贵方为___发布的招聘广告中的职位。
entries.example: I am writing in response to your advertisement for a part-time translator posted on your official website.
entries.exampleZh: 我写信是想应聘贵方在官网上发布的兼职翻译一职。
entries.note: 求职信第1段替代开头。in response to后接名词，勿写成in response of。

entries.en: I believe my qualifications and experience make me a suitable candidate for ___.
entries.zh: 我相信我的资历与经验使我成为___的合适人选。
entries.example: I believe my qualifications and experience make me a suitable candidate for this post.
entries.exampleZh: 我相信我的资历与经验使我成为这一职位的合适人选。
entries.note: 求职信第2段自荐主题句。candidate for后接职位，勿用candidate of；qualifications常用复数。

entries.en: I graduated from ___ with a bachelor's degree in ___.
entries.zh: 我毕业于___，获___学士学位。
entries.example: I graduated from Peking University with a bachelor's degree in English literature.
entries.exampleZh: 我毕业于北京大学，获英语文学学士学位。
entries.note: 求职信第2段学历介绍。介词with表“以…身份”，degree in接专业，勿漏撇号。

entries.en: I have a strong command of ___.
entries.zh: 我对___有很强的驾驭能力。
entries.example: I have a strong command of both written and spoken English.
entries.exampleZh: 我对书面英语和英语口语都有很强的驾驭能力。
entries.note: 求职信第2段能力句。command of后接语言或技能，勿中式表达I can use English freely。

entries.en: I have gained valuable experience in ___ through ___.
entries.zh: 通过___，我积累了宝贵的___经验。
entries.example: I have gained valuable experience in customer service through two years of part-time work.
entries.exampleZh: 通过两年的兼职工作，我积累了宝贵的客户服务经验。
entries.note: 求职信第2段经历句，用现在完成时；experience作“经验”时不可数，勿加s。

entries.en: Enclosed please find my résumé.
entries.zh: 随信附上我的简历。
entries.example: Enclosed please find my résumé and academic transcripts.
entries.exampleZh: 随信附上我的简历和成绩单。
entries.note: 求职信第3段附件说明。Enclosed置句首为固定倒装句，勿写I enclose please find。

entries.en: I would welcome the opportunity to discuss my application at your convenience.
entries.zh: 如您方便，我希望能有机会面谈我的申请。
entries.example: I would welcome the opportunity to discuss my application at your convenience.
entries.exampleZh: 如您方便，我希望能有机会面谈我的申请。
entries.note: 求职信末段表达面试意愿。at your convenience比when you are free正式，勿加time。

entries.en: Thank you for considering my application, and I look forward to hearing from you.
entries.zh: 感谢您考虑我的申请，期待收到您的回复。
entries.example: Thank you for considering my application, and I look forward to hearing from you at your earliest convenience.
entries.exampleZh: 感谢您考虑我的申请，期待能尽快收到您的回复。
entries.note: 求职信结尾礼貌收束。look forward to后必须接动名词hearing，勿写hear。

entries.en: I am writing to inquire about ___.
entries.zh: 我写信是想咨询___。
entries.example: I am writing to inquire about the details of your summer language program.
entries.exampleZh: 我写信是想咨询贵校暑期语言课程的具体情况。
entries.note: 咨询信第1段点题。inquire about为固定搭配，勿写inquire the details。

entries.en: I would like to obtain some information regarding ___.
entries.zh: 我想获取关于___的一些信息。
entries.example: I would like to obtain some information regarding the admission requirements of your master's program.
entries.exampleZh: 我想了解贵校硕士项目录取要求方面的一些信息。
entries.note: 咨询信第1段背景句。regarding比about正式，后接名词短语，勿接完整句子。

entries.en: I would be grateful if you could provide me with the following details.
entries.zh: 如您能提供以下详细信息，我将不胜感激。
entries.example: I would be grateful if you could provide me with the following details.
entries.exampleZh: 如您能提供以下详细信息，我将不胜感激。
entries.note: 咨询信第2段引出分条提问。provide sb with sth中with不可省，could后接动词原形。

entries.en: Could you please let me know whether ___ ?
entries.zh: 能否请您告知我是否___？
entries.example: Could you please let me know whether the course is open to non-native speakers?
entries.exampleZh: 能否请您告知我该课程是否对非母语者开放？
entries.note: 咨询信第2段第一条问题。whether从句用陈述语序，勿写whether is the course。

entries.en: I would also like to know if ___.
entries.zh: 我还想知道是否___。
entries.example: I would also like to know if accommodation is included in the tuition fee.
entries.exampleZh: 我还想知道住宿费是否包含在学费中。
entries.note: 咨询信第2段并列追问，用also衔接。if从句同样用陈述语序，勿倒装。

entries.en: In addition, I wonder if you could clarify ___.
entries.zh: 此外，我想请您明确一下___。
entries.example: In addition, I wonder if you could clarify the deadline for submitting the application form.
entries.exampleZh: 此外，我想请您明确一下提交申请表的截止日期。
entries.note: 咨询信第2段补充提问。clarify后直接接名词，勿写explain about the deadline。

entries.en: I would appreciate it if you could reply at your earliest convenience.
entries.zh: 如您能尽早回复，我将不胜感激。
entries.example: I would appreciate it if you could reply at your earliest convenience.
entries.exampleZh: 如您能尽早回复，我将不胜感激。
entries.note: 咨询信第3段请求回复。appreciate it if中it不可省，at your earliest convenience为固定搭配。

entries.en: Any information you could provide would be greatly appreciated.
entries.zh: 您能提供的任何信息我都将十分感激。
entries.example: Any information you could provide would be greatly appreciated.
entries.exampleZh: 您能提供的任何信息我都将十分感激。
entries.note: 咨询信第3段收束。information不可数，谓语用would be，勿加s或改用are。

entries.en: I am considering ___ and would appreciate your advice on ___.
entries.zh: 我正在考虑___，希望您就___给我一些建议。
entries.example: I am considering furthering my studies abroad and would appreciate your advice on the choice of universities.
entries.exampleZh: 我正在考虑出国深造，希望您能在择校方面给我一些建议。
entries.note: 咨询信第1段说明背景。consider后接动名词，advice不可数，勿写advices。

entries.en: I am writing to complain about ___.
entries.zh: 我写信是想投诉___。
entries.example: I am writing to complain about the poor quality of the laptop I purchased from your store last week.
entries.exampleZh: 我写信是想投诉上周在贵店购买的笔记本电脑的质量问题。
entries.note: 投诉信第1段点明事由。complain about后接名词，勿写complain the quality。

entries.en: I am writing to express my dissatisfaction with ___.
entries.zh: 我写信是想表达我对___的不满。
entries.example: I am writing to express my dissatisfaction with the service I received at your hotel on May 5.
entries.exampleZh: 我写信是想表达我对5月5日在贵酒店所接受服务的不满。
entries.note: 投诉信第1段替代开头。dissatisfaction with为固定搭配，语气比complain更克制。

entries.en: To my great disappointment, ___ fell far short of my expectations.
entries.zh: 令我十分失望的是，___远未达到我的预期。
entries.example: To my great disappointment, the product fell far short of my expectations.
entries.exampleZh: 令我十分失望的是，该产品远未达到我的预期。
entries.note: 投诉信第2段陈述问题。fall short of意为“未达到”，主语是物，勿写成I fell short。

entries.en: Not only was the delivery three days late, but the item was also damaged.
entries.zh: 不仅送货迟了三天，而且商品也损坏了。
entries.example: Not only was the delivery three days late, but the item was also damaged.
entries.exampleZh: 不仅送货迟了三天，而且商品也损坏了。
entries.note: 投诉信第2段并列列举两条问题。Not only置句首须部分倒装，but also连接并列成分。

entries.en: I am afraid I must ask you to look into this matter.
entries.zh: 恐怕我必须请您调查此事。
entries.example: I am afraid I must ask you to look into this matter without further delay.
entries.exampleZh: 恐怕我必须请您尽快调查此事，不要再拖延。
entries.note: 投诉信第2段末提出调查要求。I am afraid使语气委婉，look into意为“调查”。

entries.en: I would appreciate it if you could either refund my money or replace the item.
entries.zh: 如您能退款或更换商品，我将不胜感激。
entries.example: I would appreciate it if you could either refund my money or replace the item.
entries.exampleZh: 如您能退款或更换商品，我将不胜感激。
entries.note: 投诉信第3段提出解决方案。either...or连接两个动词原形，refund与replace均可作动词。

entries.en: I trust you will give this matter your prompt attention.
entries.zh: 相信您会及时处理此事。
entries.example: I trust you will give this matter your prompt attention.
entries.exampleZh: 相信您会及时处理此事。
entries.note: 投诉信末段施压收尾。give sth one's attention为固定搭配，prompt意为“及时的”。

entries.en: I have been a loyal customer of yours for years, and this is the first time I have been disappointed.
entries.zh: 我已是贵方多年的老客户，这是我第一次感到失望。
entries.example: I have been a loyal customer of yours for five years, and this is the first time I have been disappointed.
entries.exampleZh: 我已是贵方五年的老客户，这是我第一次感到失望。
entries.note: 投诉信第2段铺垫，先扬后抑。this is the first time后从句用现在完成时。

entries.en: Unless the problem is solved within ___ days, I will have no choice but to ___.
entries.zh: 如果问题在___天内得不到解决，我将别无选择，只能___。
entries.example: Unless the problem is solved within seven days, I will have no choice but to report the matter to the consumer association.
entries.exampleZh: 如果问题在七天内得不到解决，我别无选择，只能向消费者协会反映此事。
entries.note: 投诉信末段施压，考场上慎用。have no choice but to后接动词原形，勿加do。

entries.en: I am writing to express my sincere apologies for ___.
entries.zh: 我写信是想为___致以诚挚的歉意。
entries.example: I am writing to express my sincere apologies for my failure to attend your birthday party last Saturday.
entries.exampleZh: 我写信是想为我上周六未能参加你的生日聚会致以诚挚的歉意。
entries.note: 道歉信第1段点明事由。apologies for后接名词或动名词，此处形容词用sincere。

entries.en: Please accept my heartfelt apology for ___.
entries.zh: 请接受我因___而表达的诚挚歉意。
entries.example: Please accept my heartfelt apology for not being able to meet you at the airport.
entries.exampleZh: 请接受我未能去机场接你的诚挚歉意。
entries.note: 道歉信第1段替代开头。for后接动名词，heartfelt为形容词修饰apology。

entries.en: I am terribly sorry that I failed to ___.
entries.zh: 非常抱歉，我未能___。
entries.example: I am terribly sorry that I failed to return the book you lent me on time.
entries.exampleZh: 非常抱歉，我未能按时归还你借给我的书。
entries.note: 道歉信第1段说明过失。fail to do表示“未能做”，比didn't do更正式。

entries.en: The reason for my failure is that ___.
entries.zh: 我未能做到的原因是___。
entries.example: The reason for my failure is that I was suddenly taken ill that morning.
entries.exampleZh: 我未能做到的原因是那天早上我突然生病了。
entries.note: 道歉信第2段解释原因。表语从句用陈述语序，勿写is because of I was ill。

entries.en: Much to my regret, I was unable to ___ owing to ___.
entries.zh: 非常遗憾的是，由于___，我未能___。
entries.example: Much to my regret, I was unable to keep the appointment owing to an unexpected emergency.
entries.exampleZh: 非常遗憾的是，由于突发急事，我未能赴约。
entries.note: 道歉信第2段说明客观原因。owing to后接名词，与due to同义，勿接句子。

entries.en: Had I known earlier, I would have informed you in advance.
entries.zh: 如果我早点知道，我就会提前通知你了。
entries.example: Had I known earlier, I would have informed you in advance.
entries.exampleZh: 如果我早点知道，我就会提前通知你了。
entries.note: 道歉信第2段表达遗憾。Had I known为省略if的倒装，主句用would have done。

entries.en: To make up for my fault, I would like to ___.
entries.zh: 为弥补我的过失，我想___。
entries.example: To make up for my fault, I would like to treat you to dinner this weekend.
entries.exampleZh: 为弥补我的过失，我想这个周末请你吃饭。
entries.note: 道歉信第3段提出补救措施。make up for意为“弥补”，to后接动词原形。

entries.en: I sincerely hope you can forgive me.
entries.zh: 我真诚地希望你能原谅我。
entries.example: I sincerely hope you can forgive me for my carelessness.
entries.exampleZh: 我真诚地希望你能原谅我的粗心。
entries.note: 道歉信末段请求原谅。结构为forgive sb for sth，勿写forgive my fault。

entries.en: I assure you that it will never happen again.
entries.zh: 我向你保证这种事绝不会再发生。
entries.example: I assure you that it will never happen again.
entries.exampleZh: 我向你保证这种事绝不会再发生。
entries.note: 道歉信末段承诺改正。assure sb that从句用陈述语序，时态取将来时。

entries.en: I hope this unfortunate incident will not affect our friendship.
entries.zh: 希望这件不愉快的事不会影响我们的友谊。
entries.example: I hope this unfortunate incident will not affect our friendship.
entries.exampleZh: 希望这件不愉快的事不会影响我们的友谊。
entries.note: 道歉信末段修复关系。affect为动词，勿与名词effect混淆。

entries.en: I am writing to extend my warmest congratulations on ___.
entries.zh: 我写信是想对___致以最热烈的祝贺。
entries.example: I am writing to extend my warmest congratulations on your graduation from Peking University.
entries.exampleZh: 我写信是想对你从北京大学毕业致以最热烈的祝贺。
entries.note: 祝贺信第1段开门见山。congratulations on后接名词或动名词，勿用for。

entries.en: Please accept my sincere congratulations on your ___.
entries.zh: 请接受我对你___的诚挚祝贺。
entries.example: Please accept my sincere congratulations on your winning the first prize in the national contest.
entries.exampleZh: 请接受我对你在全国比赛中荣获一等奖的诚挚祝贺。
entries.note: 祝贺信第1段替代说法。on后接动名词，congratulations常用复数形式。

entries.en: I am delighted to learn that ___.
entries.zh: 得知___，我非常高兴。
entries.example: I am delighted to learn that you have been admitted to Harvard University.
entries.exampleZh: 得知你已被哈佛大学录取，我非常高兴。
entries.note: 祝贺信第1段说明喜讯来源。learn that从句用陈述语序，时态随事实而定。

entries.en: Your success is the reward for your years of hard work.
entries.zh: 你的成功是你多年努力的回报。
entries.example: Your success is the reward for your years of hard work.
entries.exampleZh: 你的成功是你多年努力的回报。
entries.note: 祝贺信第2段赞扬对方。reward for后接名词，勿写成the reward of your work。

entries.en: It comes as no surprise to me that ___.
entries.zh: 对我来说，___一点也不令人意外。
entries.example: It comes as no surprise to me that you have achieved such an outstanding result.
entries.exampleZh: 你取得如此出色的成绩，我一点也不感到意外。
entries.note: 祝贺信第2段表达“意料之中”的赞扬。it为形式主语，that从句为真正主语。

entries.en: I wish you continued success in the years ahead.
entries.zh: 祝你在未来的岁月里不断取得成功。
entries.example: I wish you continued success in the years ahead.
entries.exampleZh: 祝你在未来的岁月里不断取得成功。
entries.note: 祝贺信第3段祝愿。wish sb sth后直接接名词，勿写wish you to succeed more。

entries.en: May I take this opportunity to wish you every success in your future career.
entries.zh: 请允许我借此机会祝你未来事业一切顺利。
entries.example: May I take this opportunity to wish you every success in your future career.
entries.exampleZh: 请允许我借此机会祝你未来事业一切顺利。
entries.note: 祝贺信第3段祝愿。May置于句首构成祝愿句式，后接动词原形。

entries.en: I hope we can get together soon to celebrate your achievement in person.
entries.zh: 希望我们能尽快相聚，当面向你道贺。
entries.example: I hope we can get together soon to celebrate your achievement in person.
entries.exampleZh: 希望我们能尽快相聚，当面向你道贺。
entries.note: 祝贺信末段收尾兼邀约。in person意为“当面”，勿写in the person。
